scenes.heading: Alberta
scenes.text: On October nineteenth, Elections Alberta held a referendum. Question ten: remain in Canada, or start the legal process for a separation vote. Official results are due October twenty-ninth. No winner is called.

scenes.heading: Abuja
scenes.text: Nigeria's health ministry confirmed one Ebola case in the FCT on October twentieth. A woman from Uganda is in isolation. Officials list forty-four close contacts. Minister Muhammad Ali Pate issued the statement.

scenes.heading: Saudi Arabia
scenes.text: Britain's Defence Ministry says Typhoon jets will defend Saudi cities and will not conduct offensive strikes against the Houthis. Wes Streeting approved that on October twentieth.

scenes.heading: Sources
scenes.text: Sources are official statements. This edition awaits approval and is not published.
